name: Level_2 - Task_5
description: Evaluate the linear coupling between lattice strain and the optical phonon frequency of bulk Silicon using a machine learning regression model. Start with a primitive diamond unit cell of Silicon (a = 5.43 Å). The MACE-MP-0 foundation model should be used as the ASE-compatible calculator to describe interatomic interactions. Generate a dataset of 25 distinct deformed crystal structures by systematically applying combinations of isotropic lattice-parameter scaling (scaling the baseline lattice parameter by the fractions: -0.02, -0.01, 0.0, 0.01, 0.02) and a subsequent uniaxial strain along the z-axis (scaling the cell's c-vector by the fractions: -0.02, -0.01, 0.0, 0.01, 0.02). For each of the 25 configurations, compute the Γ-point phonons using finite-displacement methods and extract the maximum positive vibrational frequency (which corresponds to the highest optical mode) in eV. Construct a feature matrix of shape (25, 2) where the first column is the isotropic lattice-strain fraction and the second column is the uniaxial strain fraction. Construct a target vector containing the 25 extracted frequencies. Train a linear regression model on this complete dataset to predict the frequency from the strain components. Save the results locally to a JSON file named strain_phonon_results.json containing a dictionary with the keys "isotropic_coefficient" and "uniaxial_coefficient". Return the absolute path to this JSON file as your final output.
submission_format: Absolute path to the JSON file eg. '/path/to/phonon.json'
